clauses.clause: Whenever this creature or another Vampire you control dies, you may pay {B}.
If you do, target player loses 2 life and you gain 2 life.

mapping.notes: Thieves' Guild Enforcer's 'this creature or another <type> you control' on a CreatureDiesEvent; Ghostly Pilferer's may-pay at {B}; 'target player loses 2 life' as LOSE_LIFE(TARGET_PLAYER), then you gain 2. ENGINE, weaker than printed: in a dies trigger the binder pre-binds the designated player to the dead creature (TriggerBinder._put, Massacre Wurm's anaphora), so the target is never asked and you lose 2 and gain 2 (known bug pack tools/scenarios/known_bugs/kalastria_highborn_target_player_never_designated.json). packs in tools/scenarios/mapped/FDN/: kalastria_highborn_only_your_vampires.
